This document contains the code used for variance decomposition and variance component analysis as described in 'Advancing AOPs for genotoxicity through quantifying KERs linking DNA alkylation to increase in mutations and chromosome aberrations' by Winkelman et al., 2026. The output generated by this code forms the basis for Figure 3 and Figure S2.


```{r,message=F,warning=F}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(tidytext)
source('Functions_misc.R')
```


```{r}
EMSVAR = readRDS('../processedData/EMS_VarComp.rds')
MMSVAR = readRDS('../processedData/MMS_VarComp.rds')
ENUVAR = readRDS('../processedData/ENU_VarComp.rds')
```

```{r}
# =========================
# 1. INPUT LISTS
# =========================

allVARs = list(
  EMS = EMSVAR,  
  MMS = MMSVAR,
  ENU = ENUVAR
)

# =========================
# 2. DATASET LABELS + ORDER
# =========================

dataset_labels = c(
  cometVAR = "Comet assay",
  cometFpgVAR = "Comet + Fpg",
  comethAAGVAR = "Comet + hAAG",
  MNVAR = "MN assay",
  alkylVAR = "Adduct assay",
  gh2axVAR = "γH2AX assay",
  mutaVAR = "Mutation assay",
  ECDSVAR = "ECDS assay",
  CAAVAR = "CA assay"
)

dataset_order = c(
  "Adduct assay",
  "Comet + hAAG",
  "Comet + Fpg",
  "Comet assay",
  "γH2AX assay",
  "MN assay",
  "CA assay",
  "Mutation assay",
  "ECDS assay"
)

labelmapEMS = c(
  "Joint explained variance" = "Shared (non-unique)",#
  "Residual variance" = "Residual",#
  "poly(Concentration.EMS, degree = 2)" = "Concentration",#
  "Time.of.exposure..h." = "Exposure time",#
  "Scoring.automation." = "Scoring automation",#
  "Relative.survival...." = "Relative survival",#
  "expression_period" = "Expression period",#
  "S9" = "Use of S9",#
  "Assay.type" = "Assay type",#
  "Scoring.technique" = "Scoring technique",#
  "Alkylation.site" = "Alkylation site",#
  "Gene.locus" = "Gene locus",#
  "Expression.period.days." = "Expression period"#
)

labelmapMMS = c(
  "Joint explained variance" = "Shared (non-unique)",#
  "Residual variance" = "Residual",#
  "poly(Concentration.MMS, degree = 2)" = "Concentration",#
  "Time.of.exposure..h." = "Exposure time",#
  "Outcome.unit..eg...of.DNA.in.tail." = "Assay type",#
  "Scoring.automation" = "Scoring automation",#
  "Relative.survival...." = "Relative survival",#
  "expression_period" = "Expression period",#
  "S9" = "Use of S9",#
  "Assay.type" = "Assay type",#
  "Scoring.technique" = "Scoring technique",#
  "Expression.period.days." = "Expression period"#
)

labelmapENU = c(
  "Joint explained variance" = "Shared (non-unique)",#
  "Residual variance" = "Residual",#
  "poly(Concentration.ENU, degree = 2)" = "Concentration",#
  "Time.of.exposure..h." = "Exposure time",#
  "Outcome.unit..eg...of.DNA.in.tail." = "Assay type",#
  "Scoring.automation" = "Scoring automation",#
  "expression_period" = "Expression period",#
  "Scoring.technique" = "Scoring technique",#
  "Relative.survival...." = "Relative survival",#
  "Gene.locus" = "Gene locus",#
  "Target.region" = "Target region",#
  "expression_period" = "Expression period",#
  "Technique.for.scoring" = "Scoring technique"#
)

label_map = c(labelmapEMS, labelmapMMS, labelmapENU)


# =========================
# 3. BUILD DATA
# =========================

plot_df = imap_dfr(allVARs, function(model_list, compound_name) {
  imap_dfr(model_list, function(var_obj, dataset_name) {
    extract_variance_components(var_obj, dataset_name, compound_name)
  })
})

# =========================
# 4. LABELING
# =========================

plot_df = plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    dataset = dataset_labels[dataset] %>% as.character(),
    component_label = label_map[component] %>% as.character(),
    component_label = ifelse(is.na(component_label), component, component_label),
    percent = variance * 100
  )

plot_df$dataset = factor(plot_df$dataset, levels = dataset_order)

# =========================
# 5. GROUP SMALL COMPONENTS
# =========================

plot_df = plot_df %>%
  group_by(compound, dataset) %>%
  mutate(
    component_grouped = case_when(
      component_label %in% c("Residual", "Shared (non-unique)") ~ component_label,
      percent < 1 ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ component_label
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(compound, dataset, component_grouped, n_studies) %>%
  summarise(percent = sum(percent), .groups = "drop")

# =========================
# 6. ORDERING STACKS
# =========================

plot_df = plot_df %>%
  group_by(compound, dataset) %>%
  mutate(
    order_rank = case_when(
      component_grouped == "Other" ~ 4,
      component_grouped == "Shared (non-unique)" ~ 3,
      component_grouped == "Residual" ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ 1
    ),
    order_value = ifelse(order_rank == 1, -percent, 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(compound, dataset, order_rank, order_value) %>%
  ungroup()

# =========================
# 7. GLOBAL COMPONENT ORDER
# =========================

fixed_levels = c("Other", "Shared (non-unique)", "Residual")

remaining_levels = plot_df %>%
  filter(!component_grouped %in% fixed_levels) %>%
  group_by(component_grouped) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(percent), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  pull(component_grouped)

level_order = c(remaining_levels, fixed_levels)

plot_df$component_grouped = factor(
  plot_df$component_grouped,
  levels = level_order
)

# =========================
# 8. COLORS
# =========================

fixed_colors = c(
  "Other" = "pink",
  "Shared (non-unique)" = "lightblue",
  "Residual" = "gray80"
)

remaining = setdiff(level_order, names(component_colors))

spec_fun = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral"))
spec = spec_fun(length(remaining))

component_colors = c(setNames(spec, remaining), component_colors)
```



```{r}
plots = lapply(dataset_order, function(d){
  plot_assay(plot_df, d, component_colors)
})

names(plots) = dataset_order

plots
```

ggsave('../Figures/VarianceDecomposition/FigS2/ComethAAG_VarDeco.png', plots$`Comet + hAAG`, width = 3, height = 3.5)
ggsave('../Figures/VarianceDecomposition/FigS2/CometFpg_VarDeco.png', plots$`Comet + Fpg`, width = 3, height = 3.5)
ggsave('../Figures/VarianceDecomposition/FigS2/ECDS_VarDeco.png', plots$`ECDS assay`, width = 3, height = 3.5)

--New section for IR2 + Shapley--


```{r}
importance_df = purrr::imap_dfr(allVARs, function(model_list, compound_name) {
  purrr::imap_dfr(model_list, function(var_obj, dataset_name) {
    extract_importance_metrics(
      var_obj,
      dataset_name,
      compound_name,
      use_shapley = T,
      use_ir2 = TRUE   
    )
  })
})

importance_df = importance_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dataset = dataset_labels[dataset] %>% as.character(),
    dataset = factor(dataset, levels = dataset_order),
    predictor_label = label_map[predictor] %>% as.character(),
    predictor_label = ifelse(is.na(predictor_label), predictor, predictor_label)
  )
```

```{r}
plot_imp = importance_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    unique_pct = unique * 100,
    shapley_pct = shapley * 100,
    IR2_pct = if ("IR2" %in% names(.)) IR2 * 100 else NA_real_,
    ordering_value = shapley * 100   # ← ADD THIS LINE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(compound, dataset, predictor_label,
                ordering_value,
                tidyselect::ends_with("_pct")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = tidyselect::ends_with("_pct"),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "score"
  )

plot_imp = plot_imp %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    metric = factor(
      dplyr::recode(metric,
        shapley_pct = "Shapley",
        IR2_pct = "IR2",
        unique_pct = "Unique"
      ),
      levels = c("Shapley", "IR2", "Unique")
    )
  )

plot_imp = plot_imp[!(plot_imp$dataset %in% c("Adduct assay", "ECDS assay", "Comet + Fpg", "Comet + hAAG")),]
```



```{r}
make_compound_plot("EMS", plot_imp)
ggsave('../Figures/VarianceDecomposition/Fig3/EMS_importance.png', width = 6.5, height = 4)

make_compound_plot("MMS", plot_imp)
ggsave('../Figures/VarianceDecomposition/Fig3/MMS_importance.png', width = 6.5, height = 4)

make_compound_plot("ENU", plot_imp)
ggsave('../Figures/VarianceDecomposition/Fig3/ENU_importance.png', width = 6.5, height = 4)
```


--Random effects VCA--

```{r}
#Step 2

plot_df = combine_var_lists(allVARs) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = prop * 100,
    dataset_compound = paste(compound, assay, sep = "___"),
    compound = factor(compound, levels = c("EMS", "MMS", "ENU")),
    group = sub(":.*", "", grp),
    group = recode(group,
                   'DOI' = 'Manuscript',
                   'Study.index' = 'Study')
  )

#Step 3
#Enforce order of bars
plot_df = plot_df %>%
  group_by(dataset_compound) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = c(
        setdiff(
          group[order(percent, decreasing = TRUE)],
          "Residual"
        ),
        "Residual"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


ggplot(plot_df,
       aes(x = dataset_compound,
           y = percent,
           fill = group)) +
  
  geom_col(
    width = 0.7,
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~compound, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("VAR.*$", "", sub(".*___", "", x))) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "#E6C229",
      "#F58518",
      "darkred",
      "#4C78A8"
      
    ),
    guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)
  ) + 
  
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percent of total variance",
    fill = "Variance component"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
  )
```
